title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a name two or more enabled packages hold only as stored rows, and no package ships, is refused by the read naming no package instead of served by save order (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DN286opJo9xyaJevg5Unj4B)_

Fixes #32607

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no skill and no doc teaches what the read naming no package answers for a name only stored rows of several packages hold (`skills/**` and `content/docs/**` grepped: the `ambiguous-in-environment` mentions are about flow, queue and permission-set references, not `/meta` reads); the refusal's own sentence names the `?package=` remedy.

> **BREAKING** (ADR-0087 `registered`, semantic entry `two-row-holders-bare-read-refused`): the read naming no package of a name two or more enabled packages hold only as stored rows, and that no package ships in code, answers 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming each holder, where it served the row saved first. First-party count: 0. Remedy: name the package (`?package=`), which serves that package's row.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个都启用的包各自存了一行同名元数据、而没有任何包在代码里自带这个名字时，不带包名的读取（裸读 `GET /meta/TYPE/NAME`、`/published`、执行读）现在答 409 并点名这两个包；以前它按保存顺序返回先存的那一行。`/layers` 本来就答 409，保持原样不动。
- 为什么改：同一个名字，裸读答“先保存的那一行”、`/layers` 却答 409，答案取决于保存顺序，等于替调用方猜了一个包，违反史诗红线 2（歧义要报告，不许猜）。
- 风险与回滚：收紧（narrowing，BREAKING，metadata-protocol minor），第一方 0 处。只有一个包存了行、有包在代码里自带该名字、带 `?package=` 的精确读、被拒的行（declined）和定制配对行，答案都不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts` 的 `servedRowHolderOf`（`refuseWithoutDisabled` 选项与两处提前返回）；`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` 与 `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` 各一个 catch 块（让 `/layers` 继续答写入口的 409）；`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts` 的 `[#32607]` 组。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts -t 32607`，预期全部通过：两种注册顺序 × 两种保存顺序下裸读都是 409 点名两个包，单持有者 CONTROL 仍答 200。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`servedRowHolderOf` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, the row-aware served-holder judgment #32354 landed in #33130) answered only when some package was disabled. With no disabled package it returned `undefined`, so the plain read fell through to `findServedOverlayRow`, which takes the first row by save order, while `packagelessLayeredReadRefusal` counted both bindings and refused 409. Same name, two doors, two answers, and one of them a guess.

Now the item face (`readMetaItemFace`, which the plain read, `/published` and the execution face share) asks the judgment with `{ refuseWithoutDisabled: true }`:

- With no disabled holder, and only for a name no enabled package ships at any member (`shippedArtifactsOf(type, name)`, the set `packagelessContentPackage` already counts), the judgment counts the served holders exactly as it does beside a disabled one (registry holders ∪ packages the active rows are bound to, minus rows the reads decline and customization-pair rows), and refuses two or more with the by-name read's own refusal (`ambiguous-in-environment`, `details.candidates`). One or none: `undefined`, the read as it was.
- A shipped name never fell to save order: the read's own content judgment counts the shipper. So a bundled type's base shipping one member beside another package's row of another member (an email template's `en-US` shipped, a dependent's `fr-FR` row) keeps its answer. The first dogfood run on `3b9a447dc3` caught exactly that over-reach (three #28802 pins, `expected { status: 409 } to deeply equal { status: 404 }`); `abd91aad9e` adds the guard.
- Every other caller of the judgment (the layered read's re-addressing and `packagelessLayeredReadRefusal`) passes no option and is unchanged, so `/layers` keeps the package-less writes' refusal (#28337, ruling Q1 = A, 6820653691).
- A1 (6821134180) and its runtime twin (6836791341): each transport's layered chain reads the plain read first to find a disabled owner (step 1b). That read now refuses, so step 1b catches the refusal and, when step 1c (`packagelessLayeredReadRefusal`) has a refusal for the address, hands over to it; every other error is rethrown as before.

| Door, naming no package (E, F enabled, each storing a row of `d1`; no package ships `d1`) | Before | Now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `GET /meta/:type/:name` | 200, the row saved first | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `details.candidates` = E, F |
| `GET /meta/:type/:name/published` | 200, a row (`RestServer`: the row saved first; runtime dispatcher: the same package in every save order) | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming E, F |
| execution face (`getMetaItemForExecution`) | the row saved first | the same refusal |
| `GET /meta/:type/:name/layers` | 409, the package-less writes' refusal | unchanged |
| `?package=E` / `?package=F` | that package's row | unchanged |
| one package storing a row (CONTROL) | 200, that row | unchanged |
| a name an enabled package ships at any member (e.g. base ships `en-US`, a dependent stores `fr-FR`), package-less `fr-FR` read | 404 / the pair's row | unchanged |

Both transports (`RestServer`, the runtime `HttpDispatcher`), both registration orders, both save orders, and on the runtime dispatcher before and after a reboot.

Files: `protocol-meta-item-face.ts`, the A1 hunks in `rest-server.ts` and `runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`, the pins in `rest/src/meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts` and `runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`, the semantic entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.two-row-holders-bare-read-refused.ts`, and two changesets (`metadata-protocol` minor + `rest`, `runtime` patch, BREAKING, `adr-0087: registered`; `spec` patch for the entry).

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts`, describe `[#32607] RestServer: two enabled row holders and no shipper`: NARROWING over 2 registration orders × 2 save orders (plain read 409 with `details.candidates`, `/layers` and `/published` 409 naming both and serving no row, execution face rejects `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`/409, each `?package=` serves its own row); A1 (`/layers` of two enabled row holders leads with the writes' sentence); A1 CONTROLs (two code holders, and two served row holders beside a disabled one, keep the plain read's refusal on `/layers`); CONTROL (one row holder served on every bare door).
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`, describe `[#32607] two enabled row holders and no shipper`: the same NARROWING on a booted kernel over the runtime dispatcher, 2 registration orders × 2 save orders, before and after a reboot, plus the `/layers` vs `/published` sentence split; CONTROL one row holder, before and after a reboot.
- The #28337 pins (`rest/src/meta-layers-ambiguous-package.test.ts` and the runtime twin) are untouched and green.
- The shipped-name guard is pinned by the existing dogfood file `packages/qa/dogfood/test/email-template-dependent-unshipped-locale-read.dogfood.test.ts` (#28802, booted showcase), which this PR leaves untouched.

**Premise re-measured on `main` `89d7bef033`** (this branch's tests, main's three source files): the runtime `[#32607]` NARROWING pins went 4 failed / 2 passed; quoted: `{"success":true,"data":{… "label":"enabled row", "_packageId":"com.qa.row_alpha" …}}: expected [ 200, undefined ] to deeply equal [ 409, 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT' ]` (E saved first) and `… "label":"third row", "_packageId":"com.qa.row_gamma" …` (F saved first). The bare read still answered by save order.

**Ablation 1** (the item face's `{ refuseWithoutDisabled: true }` replaced by an expression esbuild folds to `false`; `metadata-protocol` rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight` found `refuseWithoutDisabled: false }` in 2 built files, and `refuseWithoutDisabled: true }` in 0): runtime 4 failed / 18 passed of 22, REST 6 failed / 33 passed of 39, exactly the NARROWING and A1 pins. Quoted: ``AssertionError: {"type":"dashboard","name":"two_rows_dash","item":{… "label":"healthy row" …}}: expected [ 200, undefined ] to deeply equal [ 409, 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT' ]``. Restore leg: `ablation-replace --restore` blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, preflight `--absent`: marker absent from all 24 built files, tree clean.

**Ablation 3** (the shipped-name guard: `!anyDisabled` replaced by `(globalThis as any).__ABL32607B === 1`; `metadata-protocol` rebuilt; preflight: marker present in 2 built files): the #28802 dogfood file 3 failed / 10 passed of 13, quoted `AssertionError: expected { status: 409 } to deeply equal { status: 404 }` (×2) and `expected { status: 409 } to deeply equal { status: 200, …(3) }`. Restore leg: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, preflight `--absent`: absent from all 24 built files, tree clean.

**Ablation 2** (REST A1: step 1b's hand-over `return false` replaced by `throw error`; the suite imports `./rest-server.js`, no build): 3 failed / 39 passed of 42: the two `[#32607] … A1` pins and the #28337 pin (`both spellings answer the package-less writes' 409 …`). Restore leg: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- This branch resumes `claude/project-thread-j3i5j5@d721d9a125` and merges `origin/main` once (`89d7bef033`, merge commit `3b9a447dc3`). The merge takes main's landed copies of every file the old branch carried from #32354's `pv4nip` and #32501 (main's #33130 and #33148), drops the patch copy `cb73bf6c`, and replays the card's own seven commits (`ef9fceb2` … `d721d9a1`) onto them. Two files conflicted: `protocol-meta-item-face.ts` (main's served-row filter for declined and pair rows, `servedAddressJudgment` and the member-selector resolution, with the card's option threaded through them) and the REST doors test (two describe blocks appended at the same place, both kept). The diff against `main` is this card's eight files only; two commits follow the merge (`abd91aad9e`, the shipped-name guard, and `5d3a6c757c`, its changeset sentence).
- Declaration moved since the claim of record: `Metadata-protocol: none` (seat ruling 6820653691) → `narrowed`, per review#1's ruling on #33121 (a refusal of a read that served before) and the seat's re-posted claim 6866219396. Hence `minor`, the BREAKING banner, `!` and the ADR-0087 entry.
- Not moved here, carried elsewhere: the paired customization address after a reboot (`?package=HOLDER.custom`, #32662); `details.candidates` on `/layers` (#32622); the REST `/layers` answer for two registry holders (#32624, sequenced after this card on the same chain).
